name: Building Gadget: Range, Safety, and Best Practices

pages.text: $(l)Range$()$(li)Range is capped at 15 blocks and cannot be increased$(li)For longer range, use the Builder’s Wand with a Dank Chest in your inventory
$(l)Safety$()$(li)The Building Gadget cannot copy or paste tile entities (e.g., machines, controllers, smeltery parts, Woot blocks)

$(l)Best Practices$()$(li)Avoid cheating in chisel blocks or storing large quantities of blocks in Dank Chests—both cause bugs$(li)Build in stages if needed, and manually place problematic blocks afterward$(li)When pasting large structures, ensure perfect alignment before committing
$(li)If misaligned, destroy manually—undoing mistakes can cause crashes
